title: PBPlus crawl Bronze v1
description: Replayable, source-oriented PBPlus directory crawler envelope. The job adds only schema_version and run_id and persists before optional geography. Known optional geography fields describe legacy/already-enriched input; the job never adds enrichment to its raw Bronze artifact. Extra source fields remain preserved. No canonical entity or analytics transformation occurs here.

run_id.description: Shared collection observation identity, safe for local filenames. Court entity identity remains the source URL.

collected_at.description: Crawler completion timestamp preserved verbatim; not publication time.

geocoded_at.description: Optional timestamp supplied by existing geography processing, never invented for raw acquisition.

count.description: Number of court records; the job additionally enforces count == len(posts).

geo_name.description: Source directory coverage, not verified per-court geography.

court.description: Unchanged source record. Known fields are optional so imperfect records remain replayable even when Silver rejects them. URL identity and nullable missing values are preserved; no administrative geography is inferred.

number_of_courts.description: Raw crawler count, retained without defaulting missing counts to zero.

address.description: May be acquired directly from the venue page before geography enrichment. Historical or externally supplied enriched replay input may also contain a geography-derived address. The normal collection job preserves the crawler's value without geocoding Bronze.

latitude.description: Optional coordinate for historical or externally supplied enriched replay input. The current crawler does not produce coordinates, and the collection job persists Bronze before geocoding.

longitude.description: Optional coordinate for historical or externally supplied enriched replay input. The current crawler does not produce coordinates, and the collection job persists Bronze before geocoding.
